tools.description: Use this when the user asks what a UK town, village or neighbourhood is like to live in. Returns MyPorta's Area Overview summary and a link to the full overview.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "search_homes" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
